groups.title: Typed clause complementation domain
groups.proposal: Compose complements from typed clause Sources, licensed semantic relations, and an exact reference graph.
groups.readingJob: Show source rank, semantic relation, reference graph, clause order, and signed sentence Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Users capture exact Results and select only relations licensed for their typed references.
groups.controlPolicy: Lesson labels, stored answers, formulas, and surfaces authorize nothing.

groups.title: Object complements
groups.proposal: Compose change, material, designation, and state object complements with exact object-reference contact.
groups.readingJob: Show principal object, complement referent, semantic category, designation structure, and category agreement.
groups.decisionSplit: Semantic category and licensed designation structure are choices; reference identity is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not accept display claims about reflexivity, category agreement, or principal object identity.

groups.title: Subject complements
groups.proposal: Compose identity, composition, state, embedded-possessor, agentive-iyoh, and passive-transformed subject complements.
groups.readingJob: Show subject contact, complement category, special contact kind, passive transformation, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The semantic category is selectable; subject and possessor contact follow exact Source identity.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not transform an object complement from a copied or displayed passive form.

groups.title: Adverbial complements
groups.proposal: Compose coverage, beginning, satisfaction, daring, cessation, tarrying, and licensed relational-lexicalized adverbial complements.
groups.readingJob: Show family, typed complement, shared reference, tense restriction, relational pair, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Family and licensed relational pair are choices; tense and reference compatibility are owner-validated.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize lexicalized pairs or bypass nearby negative gates.
